script: because Monday means going back to a job that's quietly crushing you

props.description: A slow-burn typographic scene: the word MONDAY appears large and stark on a near-black background. Hairline cracks spread outward from its center in real time, each crack lit by a cold fluorescent-office glow from beneath. The cracks halt. Then, letter by letter under the fracture, the phrase 'quietly crushing you' dissolves up in a muted ash tone — no animation flourish, just weight. Hold on the cracked MONDAY in silence for 1.5s before the scene fades.
